meta.source: AFJAGS letter of counseling/admonishment/reprimand (LOCAR) fillable form
meta.notes: Fixed paragraphs (Privacy Act, receipt and rights) and the corrective sample library were transcribed by the maintainer from the XFA stream of the AFJAGS LOCAR form. On 2026-09-15 every offence sample, and each corrective sample that cites a publication, was rewritten so that its references are current: UCMJ articles as renumbered by the Military Justice Act of 2016 (effective 1 January 2019: communicating threats is Article 115, drunken or reckless driving Article 113, and adultery is charged as extramarital sexual conduct under Article 134), DAFI 36-2903 for dress and appearance, DAFMAN 36-2905 and AFH 36-2618 for fitness, DAFI 36-2906 for financial responsibility, DAFI 36-2670 for career development courses, DAFI 36-2710 for equal opportunity, DAFI 36-2907 for the adverse action itself, and DoDI 5154.31 Volume 4 for the travel card. The form's installation-specific wording (a named base) was replaced with placeholders. The article numbers and instruction titles were written from the maintainer's knowledge of the current publications and have not been read back against a citable copy of each, so this file stays "stub" and every tool that reads it shows the unverified-data banner. Flip to "verified" once each cited publication has been checked, recording the form's edition in meta.version and its URL in meta.sourceUrl.

privacyActRuns.t: The following information required by the
To obtain any comments or documents you desire to submit
Provides you an opportunity to submit comments or documents for consideration. If provided, the comments and documents you submit become a part of the action.
Your written acknowledgment of receipt and signature is mandatory. Any other comment or document you provide is voluntary.

data.rights: You will acknowledge receipt and return this letter to me within three (3) workdays of your receipt of this letter. Your signature on this document is solely for receipt purposes and is not an admission of guilt. Any comments or documents you wish to be considered concerning this document must be submitted at that time. If you submit supporting documents they will become part of the record.
data.uifSentence: I (will) (will not) recommend that your commander file this document in your UIF.

memberFirst: I acknowledge receipt and understanding of this letter on ________________ (date).

I understand that I have until ________________ (date), which is no earlier than three (3) workdays of my receipt of this letter, to provide a response and that I must include in my response any comments or documents I wish to be considered concerning this letter.
issuerDecision: Member (did) (did not) provide written matters in response to this letter.

I have considered all matters submitted for my consideration by the member. After reviewing all of the evidence, I have determined that the member (engaged) (did not engage) in the conduct noted above and have decided (that this {{noun}} is the appropriate action) (to downgrade this letter to a ________________).
memberFinal: I acknowledge that on ________________ (date) you advised me that you had considered the matters submitted by me in response to the above {{noun}} and informed me of your final decision regarding the same.

offenseSamples.label: Adultery
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you wrongfully engaged in extramarital sexual conduct with (name), (while you were married to another person) (while the other person was married to another person). This conduct was carried out (in an open and notorious manner) (with a member of your unit) (during duty hours). Your conduct was prejudicial to good order and discipline and of a nature to bring discredit upon the armed forces, in violation of Article 134, UCMJ (Extramarital Sexual Conduct).

offenseSamples.label: Dress and Appearance Standards
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you failed to obey a lawful general regulation, DAFI 36-2903, Dress and Personal Appearance of Department of the Air Force Personnel, by (wearing a uniform that was dirty and unserviceable) (wearing your hair outside the standards the instruction prescribes) (describe the deviation and cite the paragraph). Your conduct was in violation of Article 92, UCMJ.

offenseSamples.label: Assault
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you assaulted (name), (a fellow Airman) (a security forces member) (your superior commissioned officer) (your superior noncommissioned officer) (your spouse), by (describe the assault; for example, striking him/her in the face with your fist). Your conduct was in violation of Article 128, UCMJ (Assault). (Assault on a superior commissioned officer is also a violation of Article 89, UCMJ, and assault on a superior noncommissioned officer of Article 91, UCMJ.)

offenseSamples.label: Check, Issuing Worthless
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you (made) (drew) (uttered) a check drawn on (name of financial institution), payable to (name), in the amount of $(amount), (with intent to defraud) (with intent to deceive), (knowing at the time that you did not have sufficient funds in your account for payment of the check) (and thereafter failed to maintain sufficient funds for payment upon presentment). Your conduct was in violation of Article 123a, UCMJ.

offenseSamples.label: Civilian Conviction/Misconduct
offenseSamples.text: A report received by me has disclosed that on (date), you were convicted by the (name of court) in (city, state) of (offense), in violation of (cite the state statute or local ordinance). Conduct that violates civilian law reflects on your standing as a member of the Department of the Air Force, and this action is taken under DAFI 36-2907, Adverse Administrative Actions. (Attach a copy of the police report and the court disposition to this letter.)

offenseSamples.label: Communicate a Threat
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you wrongfully communicated a threat to (name), (a fellow Airman) (a civilian), by (saying "________") (telling him/her that you intended to injure him/her or his/her property), or words to that effect. Your conduct was in violation of Article 115, UCMJ (Communicating Threats).

offenseSamples.label: Conspiracy
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you conspired with (name) to commit (offense under the UCMJ), and in furtherance of that agreement (describe the overt act). Your conduct was in violation of Article 81, UCMJ (Conspiracy).

offenseSamples.label: Damage Military Property
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you (willfully) (through neglect) (damaged) (destroyed) (lost) military property of the United States, to wit: (describe the property and the damage), of a value of about $(amount). Your conduct was in violation of Article 108, UCMJ.

offenseSamples.label: Damage Personal Property
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you (willfully and wrongfully) (through neglect) damaged property other than military property of the United States, the property of (name), to wit: (describe the property and the damage), of a value of about $(amount). Your conduct was in violation of Article 109, UCMJ.

offenseSamples.label: Debts, Dishonorable Failure to Pay
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that from about (date) to about (date), at or near (location), you dishonorably failed to pay a debt of $(amount) owed to (creditor), which was then due and payable, (despite repeated notices and demands for payment) (describe the circumstances). Your conduct was prejudicial to good order and discipline and of a nature to bring discredit upon the armed forces, in violation of Article 134, UCMJ, and contrary to DAFI 36-2906, Personal Financial Responsibility.

offenseSamples.label: Dependents, Failure to Support
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that from about (date) to about (date) you failed to provide adequate financial support to your (spouse) (child(ren)) (dependents), (in violation of a court order dated (date)) (describe the support owed and not provided). DAFI 36-2906, Personal Financial Responsibility, requires you to provide adequate financial support to your family members, and your failure to do so is contrary to that instruction.

offenseSamples.label: Dereliction of Duty
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you were derelict in the performance of your duties, in that you (willfully) (negligently) failed to (describe the duty and the dereliction), as it was your duty to do. Your conduct was in violation of Article 92, UCMJ (Dereliction in the Performance of Duties).

offenseSamples.label: Disobey a Lawful Order
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), having received a lawful order from (name), (your superior commissioned officer) (your superior noncommissioned officer) (your supervisor), to (describe the order), you (willfully disobeyed) (failed to obey) that order. Your conduct was in violation of (Article 90, UCMJ, for an order of a superior commissioned officer) (Article 91, UCMJ, for an order of a noncommissioned officer) (Article 92, UCMJ, for any other lawful order).

offenseSamples.label: Disorderly
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you were (disorderly) (drunk and disorderly) (in a public place) (on the installation), in that you (describe the conduct). Your conduct was prejudicial to good order and discipline and of a nature to bring discredit upon the armed forces, in violation of Article 134, UCMJ (Disorderly Conduct, Drunkenness).

offenseSamples.label: Disrespect
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you were disrespectful in (language) (deportment) toward (name), (your superior commissioned officer) (your superior noncommissioned officer), who was then in the execution of his/her office, by (saying "________", or words to that effect) (turning and walking away while he/she was addressing you). Your conduct was in violation of (Article 89, UCMJ, for a superior commissioned officer) (Article 91, UCMJ, for a superior noncommissioned officer).

offenseSamples.label: Driving Recklessly
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you operated a (vehicle) in a (reckless) (wanton) manner by (describe the manner of driving; for example, driving at a speed of (speed) in a (limit) zone). Your conduct was in violation of Article 113, UCMJ (Drunken or Reckless Operation of a Vehicle).

offenseSamples.label: Driving While Intoxicated
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you operated a (vehicle) while (drunk) (impaired by alcohol) (with a blood or breath alcohol concentration of (result), which is at or above the limit set by (state) law and 10 U.S.C. 913). Your conduct was in violation of Article 113, UCMJ (Drunken or Reckless Operation of a Vehicle).

offenseSamples.label: Failure to Fulfill Financial Obligations
offenseSamples.text: On (date), it was brought to my attention that you have an outstanding delinquent debt with (creditor) in the amount of $(amount). When the delinquency was addressed with you, you (claimed to be unaware of the debt) (describe your response). You have been briefed on (dates) on personal financial management and the requirements for members to meet their financial obligations. DAFI 36-2906, Personal Financial Responsibility, requires you to pay your just financial obligations in a proper and timely manner, and you have shown a pattern of failing to do so.

offenseSamples.label: Failure to Go
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), without authority, you failed to go at the time prescribed to your appointed place of duty, to wit: (building, room or place), (location), at (time). Your conduct was in violation of Article 86, UCMJ (Absence Without Leave).

offenseSamples.label: Failure to Pass CDC or EOC
offenseSamples.text: On (date), you failed your Career Development Course (course number) (end-of-course examination) for the (first) (second) time, with a score of (score). DAFI 36-2670, Total Force Development, requires you to complete the career development course for your Air Force Specialty as a condition of upgrade training, and a second failure requires your commander to decide whether you continue in the specialty.

offenseSamples.label: False Official Statement
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), with intent to deceive, you (signed an official record, to wit: (document)) (made to (name) an official statement, to wit: (describe the statement)), which statement (record) was false in that (describe the falsity), and was then known by you to be false. Your conduct was in violation of Article 107, UCMJ (False Official Statements).

offenseSamples.label: Fitness, FA Failure
offenseSamples.text: On (date), you failed to meet the minimum standards of the Department of the Air Force Physical Fitness Program set out in DAFMAN 36-2905. You (scored a composite of (score), below the minimum of 75) (failed the (component) with a (time) (count) (measurement), below the minimum component standard). This is your (first) (second) (third) failure within 24 months.

offenseSamples.label: Intoxication
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you were found drunk while on duty as (duty). Your conduct was in violation of Article 112, UCMJ (Drunkenness and Other Incapacitation Offenses).

offenseSamples.label: Leaving Place of Duty
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), without authority, you went from your appointed place of duty, to wit: (building, room or place), (location), and remained absent until (time). Your conduct was in violation of Article 86, UCMJ (Absence Without Leave).

offenseSamples.label: Misuse of GTC
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you wrongfully used your Government Travel Charge Card for (a personal purchase) (a cash withdrawal) (an expense not related to official travel), to wit: (describe the transaction, the merchant and the amount). DoDI 5154.31, Volume 4, Government Travel Charge Card Program, and the DoD Financial Management Regulation restrict the card to authorized expenses of official travel, and your use of it was in violation of Article 92, UCMJ (Failure to Obey a Lawful General Regulation).

offenseSamples.label: Receipt of Stolen Property
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you wrongfully (received) (bought) (concealed) certain stolen property, to wit: (describe the property), of a value of about $(amount), the property of (owner), which property, as you then knew, had been stolen. Your conduct was in violation of Article 134, UCMJ (Stolen Property: Knowingly Receiving, Buying, Concealing).

offenseSamples.label: Remaining in Presence of Criminal Activity by Others
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you voluntarily remained in the company of persons who were engaged in criminal activity, to wit: (describe the activity; for example, three persons in your presence were using marijuana), and you neither removed yourself nor reported the activity to proper authority. Your conduct fell below the standards of conduct expected of a member of the Department of the Air Force. (Where the member took part, cite the applicable article; wrongful use or possession of a controlled substance is a violation of Article 112a, UCMJ.)

offenseSamples.label: Sexual Harassment
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you knowingly made sexual advances, demands or requests for sexual favors, or engaged in other conduct of a sexual nature toward (name), to wit: (suggestive comments) (unwanted touching) (indecent gestures) (describe the conduct), which (was made a term or condition of that person's duties or career) (was so severe, repetitive or pervasive that a reasonable person would perceive, and the person did perceive, an intimidating, hostile or offensive environment). Your conduct was in violation of Article 134, UCMJ (Sexual Harassment), and of DAFI 36-2710, Equal Opportunity Program, which prohibits sexual harassment by any Department of the Air Force member.

offenseSamples.label: Theft
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you wrongfully took (describe the property), of a value of about $(amount), the property of (owner), with intent to permanently deprive the owner of its use and benefit, as shown by (surveillance video) (witness statements) (describe the evidence). Your conduct was in violation of Article 121, UCMJ (Larceny).

offenseSamples.label: Underage Drinking
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you wrongfully consumed an alcoholic beverage while under the age of 21, in that (describe the incident and any related behavior). Your conduct was in violation of (cite the installation's alcohol policy or the state statute), a lawful general regulation, and therefore of Article 92, UCMJ.

offenseSamples.label: Wrongful Appropriation
offenseSamples.text: Investigation has disclosed that on or about (date), at or near (location), you wrongfully appropriated (describe the property), of a value of about $(amount), the property of (the United States) (name), with intent to temporarily deprive the owner of its use and benefit (by taking it for your own use) (by lending it to another without authority). Your conduct was in violation of Article 121, UCMJ (Wrongful Appropriation).

correctiveSamples.label: Dress and Appearance Standards
correctiveSamples.text: You may not consider dress and appearance standards important, but I assure you that I do. If I cannot depend upon you to follow DAFI 36-2903, I cannot depend upon you to follow other orders. Henceforth, I expect you to be a model of the standards in DAFI 36-2903. A repetition of this or any other violation will be dealt with more severely.

correctiveSamples.label: Adultery
correctiveSamples.text: As an Airman in the United States Air Force, you are expected to maintain a standard of professional and personal behavior that is above reproach. Your behavior surrounding the above offense falls far below any reasonable standard for a person in your position. This misconduct demonstrates an appalling lack of character, and has caused me to seriously question your judgment. I expect that you will refrain from engaging in illicit relationships such as this in the future. If you engage in any similar misconduct, it may be met with more serious adverse action taken against you.

correctiveSamples.label: Assault
correctiveSamples.text: I want you to know that your conduct was criminal. Many people have received Article 15s and have been court-martialed for the crime of assault. People have the right to be secure in their person from fear of bodily harm at the hands of another. Regardless of how you feel, I will not tolerate you resorting to assault to solve your problems. The Air Force and this unit cannot tolerate the adverse consequences of your behavior, and you cannot afford the sanctions that a repeat performance will cause. Henceforth, I expect you to be an exemplary model for your subordinates and your peers.

correctiveSamples.label: Check, Issuing Worthless
correctiveSamples.text: I want you to realize that issuing a worthless check is a crime under the Uniform Code of Military Justice. Your misconduct should have resulted in Article 15 or court-martial action. You have adversely affected your fellow airmen by blemishing the fine image which they project. I fully expect you never to resort to such behavior again. If you do, expect stronger and quicker action to be taken against you.

correctiveSamples.label: Civilian Conviction/Misconduct
correctiveSamples.text: You are hereby reprimanded for the incident outlined above. Military custom and tradition require a high standard of conduct of all airmen. This standard of conduct relates not only to military duties, but the discharge of your civic responsibilities and your relation with the civilian community. You are well aware that as an airman you are duty-bound to hold sacred the honor and prestige of the United States Air Force in your duty and in your community. (The seriousness of this matter, together with the lack of responsibility, judgment and good sense you displayed on this occasion, compels me to caution you that any recurrence can only jeopardize your career). By your actions, you have caused discredit to fall upon this organization and the Air Force.

correctiveSamples.label: Communicate a Threat
correctiveSamples.text: By communicating a threat to ______ you committed a crime. The Congress of the United States and I share the common belief that no one should have to be subjected to your threats. I expect you to handle any differences you have with any person in a legal and mature fashion. Do not be deceived into thinking that you have a license to misbehave by the lenient manner in which I have treated you. I will take harsher action for any further misconduct.

correctiveSamples.label: Conspiracy
correctiveSamples.text: I want you to realize that conspiring with others to commit a crime is, in itself, a crime. As a member of the military, you must always abstain from criminal conduct. Your action has brought discredit upon this unit and yourself. Consider yourself fortunate because Article 15 and even court-martial action is warranted by your conduct. I expect you to redeem yourself by hard work and a clean record, and to never again conduct yourself in such a manner.

correctiveSamples.label: Damage Military Property
correctiveSamples.text: I want you to understand that damaging military property is a crime. The damage you caused has resulted in needless expenses for repair, waste of manpower, and degradation of mission capabilities. Remember that you are in the Air Force to enhance mission capabilities, not to detract from them. Consider this statement a forewarning that your future conduct will be more closely scrutinized and know that any more misbehavior will result in my taking stronger action against you.

correctiveSamples.label: Damage Personal Property
correctiveSamples.text: By damaging the personal property of another, you committed a crime. Consider yourself fortunate that you are only being reprimanded, but note that any recurrence will result in harsher sanctions. Each person has the right to believe that other people will respect his property, but you have shown that any such beliefs in you are ill-founded. You and you alone have the opportunity to restore the faith of others in you. I believe that this should be your goal, but even if this is not important to you, you had better heed this warning and refrain from further misconduct of any type.

correctiveSamples.label: Debts, Dishonorable Failure to Pay
correctiveSamples.text: By failing to pay your just debts, you have brought discredit upon yourself and the United States Air Force. As an Air Force member, you are expected and required to manage your financial affairs in a way which ensures that your creditors receive what is rightly owed them. Your conduct has tarnished the high regard most businessmen have for Air Force members. I hope that you have seen the error of your ways, and I expect you to become a model airman. I will not be as lenient with you if you repeat the same misconduct.

correctiveSamples.label: Dependents, Failure to Support
correctiveSamples.text: Your monthly compensation is increased because of your obligations to your dependents and I fully expect you to meet those obligations. Failure to support one's dependents casts a particularly unpleasant shadow over both you and the Air Force.

correctiveSamples.label: Dereliction of Duty
correctiveSamples.text: If any task is worth doing, it is worth doing well. At a minimum, it is worth doing satisfactorily. By definition, your dereliction fell below minimum standards and was the result of conscious behavior. In addition to being irresponsible, it is a crime. In the future, I expect you to take more pride in your job and in helping this unit accomplish its mission. Rest assured that I will be watching you closely, and in the event you degrade this unit's mission again by your dereliction, I will take swift and sure action against you.

correctiveSamples.label: Disobey a Lawful Order
correctiveSamples.text: I want you to know that I consider disobeying a lawful order to be one of the most serious offenses an Air Force member can commit. Strict adherence to orders is the only way that any military force anywhere in the world can execute its mission, whether that mission is offensive or defensive. Our unit is no different. You have damaged its mission capability by identifying yourself as one who cannot be depended upon to perform as ordered. You are going to have to strive diligently if you ever hope to reestablish your dependability. Any repetition of this totally unacceptable behavior will result in stronger action against you.

correctiveSamples.label: Disorderly
correctiveSamples.text: Military custom and tradition require a high standard of conduct of all airmen, particularly non-commissioned officers. This standard of conduct relates not only to performance of military duties but the discharge of your civic responsibilities and your relations with the civilian community. The seriousness of this matter, together with the lamentable lack of responsibility, judgment and common sense displayed on this occasion, compel me to caution you that any recurrence can only jeopardize your career. Your actions have caused me to question your ability to perform as an NCO. I expect you to heed these remarks and act accordingly in the future.

correctiveSamples.label: Disrespect
correctiveSamples.text: I will not tolerate disrespect by anyone in this organization toward any of their superiors. Your disrespect has been detrimental to unit morale and discipline. I fully expect you will never repeat such conduct. If you do, expect more serious consequences.

correctiveSamples.label: Driving Recklessly
correctiveSamples.text: Reckless driving is a dangerous, criminal act, a violation of Article 113, UCMJ. By issuing you a driver's license, the state has permitted you to operate a useful, yet potentially dangerous instrumentality, an automobile. The Air Force has also permitted you to operate your automobile on this installation. You have abused the trust placed in you by your reckless driving. (You have also jeopardized the safety of the Air Force members and families who share the roads with you.) I will not tolerate this conduct, and any recurrence will be dealt with more severely and may include loss of your installation driving privileges.

correctiveSamples.label: Driving While Intoxicated
correctiveSamples.text: Driving while intoxicated is a crime. It is also a dangerously irresponsible act. You did not care who occupied the roadway with you while you were intoxicated, nor did you consider the consequences of drinking and driving not only on yourself but innocent individuals whom you may come into contact with while driving. The Air Force cannot afford to lose people, its most valuable resource, because you choose to drink and drive. I absolutely will not tolerate this deplorable behavior. You are most fortunate that you did not harm anyone by choosing to drink and drive. If you ever drink and drive again, I will take the most severe action allowable against you. Many airmen have received Article 15s or have been court-martialed for driving while intoxicated. I hope that you do not fall victim to thinking that the lenient manner in which I am handling your offense gives you a license to continue such criminal behavior or indicates that I condone drunken driving. I am, in fact, appalled by your conduct, conduct that has discredited you and blemished the image of all airmen. If you do not take this opportunity to prove your potential, or if you involve yourself in any further misconduct, I will take much stronger action.

correctiveSamples.label: Failure to Fulfill Financial Obligations
correctiveSamples.text: A member of the United States Air Force is expected to maintain the highest standards of personal conduct, responsibility, and integrity. As a military member it is your requirement to effectively manage your finances and live within your means. Your failure to do so adversely affects mission readiness and it compromises both your credibility and trustworthiness. You should make every effort to ensure your future conduct is above reproach.

correctiveSamples.label: Failure to Go
correctiveSamples.text: In the Air Force, failure to go is a crime. I assure you that many airmen have been given Article 15s and have been court-martialed for similar conduct. This unit, this wing, and indeed, the entire Air Force, cannot function when members become undependable. You have proven that you cannot always be depended upon, and consequently, you have damaged this unit's mission capabilities. I expect you to work diligently at redeeming yourself and proving that you are dependable.

correctiveSamples.label: Failure to Pass CDC or EOC
correctiveSamples.text: Your failure to pass your career development course shows a lack of responsibility on your part. You were made aware of the importance of completing it, and of what DAFI 36-2670, Total Force Development, requires of you in upgrade training, yet you failed for the (first) (second) time. Be advised that a second failure requires a decision on whether you continue in your Air Force Specialty, and that it places your Air Force career in severe jeopardy.

correctiveSamples.label: False Official Statement
correctiveSamples.text: In the Air Force, making a false official statement is a criminal act. You can consider yourself fortunate because many airmen have received Article 15s or have been court-martialed for such deplorable conduct. I cannot and will not tolerate this type of behavior in this unit. Untruths and half-truths degrade the mission of the Air Force, a mission which can only be accomplished by trustworthy people. Having identified yourself as one requiring close supervision, you can expect to have your future actions closely scrutinized. Rest assured that I will react strongly to any further misbehavior on your part.

correctiveSamples.label: Fitness, FA Failure - Amn
correctiveSamples.text: Your failure to meet the minimum standards of DAFMAN 36-2905, Department of the Air Force Physical Fitness Program, is unacceptable. It also falls short of the expectation in AFH 36-2618, The Enlisted Force Structure, that every Airman be physically ready to accomplish the mission and always meet fitness standards. It is your responsibility to develop a personal nutrition and exercise plan that will bring you to a passing score on your reassessment. If you are unable to improve your fitness assessment score, more severe action may be taken against you, which could include involuntary separation from the Air Force.

correctiveSamples.label: Fitness, FA Failure - NCO
correctiveSamples.text: Your failure to meet the minimum standards of DAFMAN 36-2905, Department of the Air Force Physical Fitness Program, is unacceptable. It also falls short of the expectation in AFH 36-2618, The Enlisted Force Structure, that noncommissioned officers be physically ready to accomplish the mission, always meet fitness standards, and set a positive example for their subordinates. It is your responsibility to develop a personal nutrition and exercise plan that will bring you to a passing score on your reassessment. You have fallen far short of the NCO charge. If you are unable to improve your fitness assessment score, more severe action may be taken against you, which could include involuntary separation from the Air Force.

correctiveSamples.label: Intoxication
correctiveSamples.text: I absolutely will not tolerate on-duty intoxication from any person in this organization. You are paid and fully expected to be able to do your job every day. Because of your intoxication, you failed to do your job, jeopardized unit safety, and seriously damaged morale in this unit. I expect you to never repeat such deplorable conduct or misbehave in any other way. If you do, I will take stronger action against you.

correctiveSamples.label: Leaving Place of Duty
correctiveSamples.text: By leaving your place of duty without authority, you committed a crime. By your conduct, you proved that you are not trustworthy. Further, you injured this unit's missions capabilities. I will not tolerate any further conduct of this kind. Also, I will be closely monitoring your performance to see if you are up to the task of redeeming yourself.

correctiveSamples.label: Misuse of GTC
correctiveSamples.text: Your decision to use your Government Travel Charge Card for an unauthorized transaction clearly demonstrates a lapse in judgment and has caused me to question whether you can be trusted with matters of importance. The card is issued for the expenses of official travel and nothing else, as DoDI 5154.31, Volume 4, and the DoD Financial Management Regulation make plain, and you acknowledged those rules when you accepted it. I expect you to demonstrate that this was an isolated incident by strict compliance with the rules that govern the card. Failure to do so will result in more severe action, which may include cancellation of the card and further administrative or disciplinary action.

correctiveSamples.label: Receipt of Stolen Property
correctiveSamples.text: Knowingly (receiving, buying, or concealing) stolen property is a crime. By engaging in such conduct, you aided a thief in covering his steps and profiting from his criminal conduct. You also brought disrespect upon yourself and the United States Air Force. I will not tolerate further misconduct by you of any type.

correctiveSamples.label: Remaining in Presence of Criminal Activity by Others
correctiveSamples.text: Your presence at the scene while these crimes were being committed identifies you as a person who condones criminal activity. You should be aware that your mere presence might, in certain situations, result in your being prosecuted for offenses committed by others. You have a duty to yourself to avoid criminals, and you have a duty to the Air Force to report any crime that you observe to responsible officials. I trust that this warning will point out to you the serious implications of your conduct and that you will avoid anyone involved in any criminal activity.

correctiveSamples.label: Sexual Harassment
correctiveSamples.text: I have reviewed your service record and it convinces me that you can still make valuable contributions to the Air Force. However, you must closely examine your attitude and behavior toward others to avoid more severe penalties in the future. Counseling from the Equal Opportunity office may be appropriate if you have any question in your mind about what constitutes appropriate or inappropriate behavior. Conduct of this nature is precisely what DAFI 36-2710, Equal Opportunity Program, prohibits, and since 2022 it is a specified offense under Article 134, UCMJ. Unwanted sexual attention creates an intimidating and offensive environment for the person who receives it, to the prejudice of good order and discipline. It will not be tolerated.

correctiveSamples.label: Theft
correctiveSamples.text: A member of the United States Air Force is expected to maintain the highest standards of personal conduct, responsibility, and integrity. You are far from meeting those standards. Your actions were in direct violation of Article 121 of the Uniform Code of Military Justice, and many Airmen have received nonjudicial punishment or been court-martialed for larceny.

correctiveSamples.label: Underage Drinking
correctiveSamples.text: Your actions evidence a stunning lack of judgment and maturity. As Airmen, our conduct must be above reproach and demonstrate steadfast compliance with all laws and regulations. Your deliberate decision to consume alcohol while underage demonstrates that you lack interest in upholding standards and abiding by the law. I expect that you will do everything in your power to undo this negative image and will refrain from consuming alcohol until it is legal for you to do so.

correctiveSamples.label: Wrongful Appropriation
correctiveSamples.text: Wrongfully appropriating (military, your fellow Airman's or name) property is a crime. I will not tolerate theft by anyone in this organization. By your conduct, you created animosity within this unit and damaged its mission capabilities. Additionally, your misconduct has brought discredit upon yourself. I expect you to never repeat such unpardonable behavior. Should you decide to not heed this warning, harsher punishment will be forthcoming.

correctiveSamples.label: General Closure Officers - 1
correctiveSamples.text: As a commissioned officer, you are expected to conduct yourself at all times in a manner which will set a good example and earn for you the respect of the junior officers and Airmen who look to you for leadership and guidance. I expect that my action in this case will bring you to a full realization of your professional obligations and responsibilities and that you will conduct yourself in the future so as to make any further administrative or disciplinary action against you unnecessary.

correctiveSamples.label: General Closure Officers - 2
correctiveSamples.text: As a commissioned officer you are expected to maintain a standard of professional and personal behavior that is above reproach. Your honor and behavior as an officer should serve as a model for junior officers and airmen to emulate. Your behavior regarding the above offense is entirely incompatible with the standards expected of an officer in the United States Air Force.

correctiveSamples.label: General Closure Enlisted - 1
correctiveSamples.text: I sincerely hope you understand the wrongfulness of your conduct and appreciate the seriousness of this administrative action. The magnitude of this matter, together with the lamentable lack of responsibility, judgment and good sense you displayed compel me to caution you that your career is in jeopardy. Any recurrence of this behavior will lead to more serious consequences.

correctiveSamples.label: General Closure Enlisted - 2
correctiveSamples.text: Be advised that if another derogatory incident concerning you is brought to my attention, I shall no longer be in doubt regarding your competence to represent the noncommissioned officer corps, or in fact, remain a member of the United States Air Force. The same forcefulness you have exhibited in attaining your present grade and performing your military duties must now be channeled to the exercise of your personal affairs.

correctiveSamples.label: Making Racial, Sexist, or Ethnic Remarks
correctiveSamples.text: Making racial, sexist, or ethnic remarks, including telling racial, sexist, or ethnic jokes, is totally unacceptable and is prohibited by DAFI 36-2710, Equal Opportunity Program. Your conduct has created tension and hostility within this unit and has had a detrimental effect upon morale. I will not tolerate this type of conduct. I fully expect you to heed this warning and refrain from this and all other misbehavior. If you do not, expect the harshest of consequences.

correctiveSamples.label: Permitting Racial, Sexist, or Ethnic Remarks
correctiveSamples.text: Permitting racial, sexist or ethnic jokes or comments to be made in your work area is totally unacceptable. As a supervisor in the Air Force, you have the responsibility under DAFI 36-2710, Equal Opportunity Program, to maintain a workplace free of harassment and discrimination, to remain impartial, and to support equal opportunity for all persons. If you cannot remain impartial, you are not fit to supervise. Your inaction has been detrimental to this unit's mission and has caused me to question your judgment. I expect you to correct this at once.

correctiveSamples.label: Conduct Unbecoming an Officer-off duty
correctiveSamples.text: Military Law, custom and tradition require a high standard of conduct of all officers. These standards of conduct relate not only to performance of military duties, but to the discharge of your responsibilities and your relations with other members of the military community as well. Your behavior is entirely incompatible with that expected of an officer. (I have carefully reviewed your statement regarding the incident, and can find no justification for the irresponsible behavior exhibited on this occasion). The seriousness of the matter, together with the lamentable lack of responsibility, judgment and good sense you displayed compel me to caution you that any recurrence can only jeopardize your career. I expect that you will heed these remarks and act accordingly in the future.

correctiveSamples.label: Conduct Unbecoming an Officer-junior officers
correctiveSamples.text: Your unprofessional behavior in the presence of junior officers falls well below the standards of personal conduct expected of commissioned officers on duty and thereby has brought discredit upon yourself, the officer corps and the United States Air Force. I find particularly reprehensible the fact that, (describe aggravating circumstances). As a senior (captain, officer), you must be a leader, not a miscreant. correctiveSamples.label: Appearance and Dress Standards
correctiveSamples.text: You may not consider dress and appearance standards important, but I assure you that I do.
